newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka Central bank says cut state trading agencies.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka Central bank says cut state trading agencies.

text.p: Sri Lanka's Central Bank on Wednesday called for control or elimination of state trading agencies, saying their presence led to market distortions.

The bank said in its annual report that the powers of the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) and the Paddy Marketing Board (PMB) should be curtailed and the private sector given a greater role in developing the agricultural market.
The bank said it may not be advisable to further expand the CWE as a completely state-owned outfit. The CWE is the central tendering body for imports of grains and other foodstuff.
The report also said "It is hard to justify the continuation of the Paddy Marketing Board", adding the time may be right to wind up its operations.
